Come for your flat white. Stay for the sourdough, the slow mornings and the good company.

Can I pop in without a reservation?+

Of course. In this café concept, a few tables are always kept for walk-ins. Reservations are recommended for weekend breakfast.

Do you have plant-based options?+

Yes. Oat milk is available for all coffees, alongside vegan breakfast, lunch and bakery options. Dietary labels are shown on our sample menu. Please always discuss allergies with staff.

Can I bring my laptop or my dog?+

In our café concept, well-behaved dogs are welcome and Wi-Fi is available. We keep the communal table laptop-friendly on weekdays, and the smaller tables for conversation.
